sources.title: Towns and cities, characteristics of built-up areas, England and Wales
sources.methodology: Supports a deliberately limited set of high-confidence named-place anchors and the London exception. Turning Pages identity and current administrative relations are reviewed mappings, not an exhaustive gazetteer or direct polygon derivation.

sources.title: Authored UK settlement world-completion content
sources.methodology: Deterministic keyed name composition and administrative placement complete playable coverage around preserved real anchors. V2 preserves the v1 authored selection seed, treats Cardiff and Belfast as compact major-city authorities, and treats Cefn as a separate Welsh name component. Administrative population is used only as a coarse record-count heuristic. No generated record is statistical evidence or carries a population count.
sources.licence: Original Turning Pages authored game content.

names.text: Margaidh Ùr, Lacasdal and Bruach Mairi (Newmarket, Laxdale and Marybank)

decisions.description: Maps a high-confidence official named-place anchor to a durable Turning Pages Settlement identity and conservatively reviewed 2024 administrative relation; it is not an exhaustive or geometry-derived inventory.
Places each authored synthetic Settlement wholly within one frozen local administrative Place as explicit world content. The relation is authored, not inferred from official geometry.
Selects stable region-aware synthetic display names from versioned curated components using keyed deterministic derivation. Plausibility is a game-content goal, not an official naming claim.
Reviews every v2 Settlement identity reused from the immutable v1 candidate as the same durable human place; the separate continuity ledger records every continued and historical-only identity.

gaps.description: Exact April 2024 OS Open Names and Built Up Areas binaries remain unavailable, so England and Wales official identity coverage is selective and completed with explicit authored content.
NISRA/LPS Settlement Development Limit geometry redistribution remains unresolved; selected tabular real anchors and authored completion are used without geometry claims.
NRS Localities use an official population threshold and do not exhaust smaller recognised places; authored completion is explicitly non-empirical.

limitations: Administrative population affects only synthetic record-count heuristics and is not Settlement population evidence.
England and Wales real anchors are deliberately selective because exact historical OS Open Names and Built Up Areas binaries were unavailable; authored completion is not a statistical gazetteer.
NRS Localities omit smaller Scottish places below the official method threshold; synthetic completion may represent additional plausible places without claiming empirical identity.
Northern Ireland real anchors use licence-safe tabular identity evidence and reviewed current administrative placement; restricted SDL geometry is not bundled or represented as an official overlay.
Synthetic names, opaque kinds and contained-by relations are authored gameplay abstractions and must never be presented as official source facts.
The package contains no hierarchy, geometry, coordinates, settlement population, Residence, Presence, Travel or player assignment.
